title: Just Enough Hydration!
description: This mod gives you a hydration bar! Stay Hydrated!
body:
# JEH - Just Enough Hydration!

**JEH** Transforms minecraft and allows it to have hydration! You need to drink a water bottle (or a bottle of water, whichever is in minecraft) and will hydrate you! If you eat food until your hydration levels are low? You'll get a warning for you to drink water!

---

## ✨ Features
Hunger effect when hydration is fully drained
Hydration level changes when you eat certain types of food
Hydration level also takes up some of your healing! (BETA)

## 🎮 How It Works

When you eat your food, IRL and in game, you always need some water right? to prevent hic-ups, so i added hydration to minecraft! you need to hydrate quite a few times, if you get damaged, you need some hydration with your food (hungerbar) to heal, Right? So i added that as well!

---

## 📦 Installation

1. Install **Fabric API** for 26.2
2. Drop the Just Enough Hydration V1.2.jar into your `mods` folder
3. Launch the game!

### Dependencies
- Minecraft **26.2**
- Fabric API **for 26.2**
